tools.name: get_property_info
tools.description: General information about Appartements Amrusch: apartment types, what is included, rules (minimum stay, check-in), season dates, location, distances and contact.

tools.name: find_available_dates
tools.description: Search for free stays in a date range, e.g. "a week in July for 4 people". Returns up to 12 possible arrival/departure options with the apartment types that are free.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Real-time availability and exact total price for given dates, per apartment type, plus a pre-filled booking link for the guest.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send a NON-BINDING inquiry to the Amrusch family on behalf of the guest. Only use this when the guest has explicitly agreed to send it and provided their name and email address. The guest receives an email with a confirmation link; the family only sees the inquiry after the guest confirms. No bookin
